## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

If last week was quiet whale reshuffling, this week was open combat. A mystery whale moved $487M. A 3-year ETH holder cracked at a $19M loss. And BitMine’s ETH treasury quietly crossed $11 billion.

Bitcoin closed Sunday at $64,844 (*close), up 2.1% w/w, but the real story was the ETF flip. Spot BTC ETFs pulled in $853.5M after last week’s $61.5M outflow, the sharpest reversal since spring.

_**Let’s get into it...**_

Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. Mystery Whale Just Dumped 7,513 BTC in Three Weeks**

An unidentified wallet[ sold](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2086609652507423184) another 1,019 BTC worth $66.4M on August 9, per Lookonchain. That brings the wallet’s three-week total to 7,513 BTC, or roughly $486.9M distributed into strength while everyone else was buying. Identity still unconfirmed.

This seller has been steady, not panic-dumping, just methodically distributing.

_**Whale Intel: **__One anonymous seller moving $487M without moving the tape says more about market depth than the seller. Someone is absorbing._

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8e321ee2-c579-4bb8-89cd-3f1d58aec60b/image.jpeg?t=1786512501)
Caption: _Mystery whale summary | Source: Lookonchain via X, August 9, 2026_

### **2. Strategy Sold Another 1,690 BTC. Saylor Says That Is Fine.**

Michael Saylor’s Strategy[ disclosed](https://x.com/saylor/status/2086785552355860895) in an[ August 10 Form 8-K](https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltf8d808d9b8cebd37/blt5753b925d6f68e09/6a794ef9dcb43781cc2cf7c3/form-8-k_08-10-2026.pdf) that it sold 1,690 BTC between August 3 and 9 at an average price of $64,262 per coin, generating $108.6M. All of it went to buying back STRC preferred stock, not adding BTC. Strategy still holds 840,447 BTC and has now gone seven straight weeks without a purchase.

Saylor’s new Digital Credit Capital Framework, adopted June 29, treats bitcoin as deployable treasury capital rather than an untouchable reserve. The immediate priority: dragging[ STRC](https://www.strategy.com/strc) preferred stock back to its $100 par value (trading around $94.35).

Treasury yields declined and bitcoin barely moved, holding the $64,000 area before slipping just under it, while ether pushed higher toward $1,915. Harmony said in Asian morning hours that it is coordinating with exchanges to freeze funds and preparing a software fix. More details 🏛️ Bank of England to test stablecoins and a digital pound in cross-border finance The BOE-led Digital Pound Lab will trial trade-finance interoperability in which exporters receive stablecoins while importers settle in a potential digital pound. It is one of the most concrete signals yet that a major central bank sees privately issued stablecoins and public digital money operating side by side rather than in competition. Read more 💼 Fidelity moves to add staking and quarterly payouts to its ether ETF Fidelity filed to introduce staking to its roughly $900 million ether fund, with rewards distributed to shareholders on a quarterly basis. The structure keeps 85% of gross staking rewards for the fund, with the remaining 15% routed to service providers — a template other issuers are likely to copy.
